description: This file defines the 'TaxTemplate' class for configuring tax templates within an Odoo module, including methods for retrieving and updating tax-related data, and actions for UI interactions.

classes.name: TaxTemplate
classes.description: A class for managing tax template configurations, including default values, onchange handlers, and UI actions.

methods.name: _get_tax
methods.description: Retrieves the current tax template ID based on internal step index.

methods.name: _get_collected
methods.description: Retrieves the collected tax account ID for the current tax template.

methods.name: _get_paid
methods.description: Retrieves the paid/refund tax account ID for the current tax template.

methods.name: on_change_collected
methods.description: Updates the account_collected_id of a tax template when changed in the UI.

methods.name: on_change_paid
methods.description: Updates the account_paid_id of a tax template when changed in the UI.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Returns an action to cancel the current configuration and open the wizard form.

methods.name: action_new
methods.description: Advances to the next tax template or marks completion, then opens the configuration wizard form.
